briefHtml:
NAV S$10,405,638 (-0.24% day; listed book -1.27%)

  • Biggest mover: silver miners again — SILJ -4.2%, GDX -3.9%, SLVP -3.4% (Sep 2 US close); silver futures bouncing +2.0% overnight to ~US$65.9/oz.
  • Key thing: market prices ~60-70% chance of a Fed HIKE on Sep 15-16 (Chair Warsh) — that repricing, not Iran, drove this week's metals/miner slide. US payrolls Friday is the next swing factor.

Portfolio moves (Sep 2 closes)

  • US ETFs: GDX -3.9%, SILJ -4.2%, SLVP -3.4%, VNM +0.3%.
  • SGX: CDL +2.1%, DBS +0.9% (77.60), UOL +0.3%; Seatrium -2.3%, YZJ -2.1%, VICOM -1.1%; STI +0.6% to 5,744.
  • HK: Xiaomi +1.8%, Tencent -0.7%, SMIC -0.9%; HSI 25,311.
  • Metals: silver settled ~US$64.6 Sep 2 (4th down day, ~5% off late-Aug ~$68); gold Dec futures ~US$4,434 after four down sessions from ~$4,510.

Insider trades (SGX/HK, 7d)

  • None found in public web sources for held names. SGXNet/HKEX feeds are poorly indexed — none surfaced, not proof of absence.

Congress trades

  • Rep. Michael Rulli (R-OH, House): SOLD GOOGL US$50,001-100,000, traded Aug 24, disclosed late Aug. Meets the US$50K watch threshold. Source

Trump / policy watch (24-48h)

  • Fed hawkish repricing: ~60-70% odds of +25bp on Sep 15-16; 10y UST 4.78-4.80% (highest since Jan 2025), 30y ~5.28%. ADP today, payrolls Friday.
  • US-Iran war: fresh strikes on IRGC targets Sep 1; Trump ruled out nuclear use; Brent ~US$95.6 — energy inflation feeding the bond selloff.
  • Canada: counter-tariffs on C$27.6bn of US goods effective Sep 8; steel/aluminum counter-tariffs rise to 50%.
  • G20: all but China back action vs non-market policies; chair statement flags rare-earth export restrictions; Bessent pressing BOJ to hike Sep 17-18. JGB 10y hit 3%, first since 1996.
  • Singapore: SORA bottomed and drifting up (1M ~1.25%); DBS raised fixed mortgage rates Sep 1; MAS neutral, next review Oct.

Risk

  • Watcher riskFlags: none today. Yesterday saw silver -6.8% intraday and miners -8 to -10%.
  • Leveraged silver (IBKR): 1,777 oz ~S$149k vs ~S$56,240 loan (~1.5x). A -6.7% silver day ~ -10% account equity; cushion thinner after this week's slide.
  • FX: ~35% of net worth non-SGD; SGD near 2026 highs (USDSGD 1.2712). CNY piles ~S$1.65m are the largest single FX exposure.
  • Concentration: ~62% of the liquid book is idle cash — low market risk, high repricing risk if the Fed re-hikes.
  • Rates vs SGD income sleeve: rising SORA pressures REIT/developer block even as it helps DBS margins.

Alpha — signals, not advice

  • GDX/SILJ: real-assets sleeve ~4% vs 20% target after a 13-14% two-day miner flush on rate repricing; soft payrolls Friday = recovery start, hot print = better entry later.
  • SMIC (0981.HK): AI-bottleneck target 15% vs ~1% filled; China AI-sovereignty chokepoint, -0.9% while NVDA-MediaTek shows capex cycle intact — accumulation zone while pressure is rates-driven.
  • US duration/TIPS: defense sleeve 0% vs 15% target; 10y 4.78% / 30y 5.28% — 10y at/above 5.0% around the FOMC = zone to start building.

trumpWatch.title: Fed hike repricing (Sep 15-16 FOMC)
trumpWatch.detail: Markets price ~60-70% odds of a +25bp hike (funds rate 3.50-3.75%) after hawkish remarks from Chair Kevin Warsh; 10y UST 4.78-4.80% (highest since Jan 2025), 30y ~5.28%. Drove the 4-day gold/silver correction hitting the real-assets sleeve. ADP Wed and payrolls Fri are the next catalysts.

trumpWatch.title: US-Iran war escalation
trumpWatch.detail: Fresh US strikes on IRGC targets at noon ET Sep 1; Trump publicly ruled out nuclear use Aug 31. Brent ~US$95.6, WTI ~US$90-91, highest since July; energy inflation is feeding the global bond selloff.

trumpWatch.title: Canada counter-tariffs effective Sep 8
trumpWatch.detail: C$27.6bn of US imports targeted, dollar-for-dollar response to US Section 338 tariffs; steel/aluminum counter-tariffs rise 25% to 50%. US-Canada trade conflict still escalating.

trumpWatch.title: G20 backs action vs non-market policies (China isolated)
trumpWatch.detail: All G20 finance chiefs except China backed action on distorted trade; chair statement urged avoiding export restrictions on critical minerals (rare-earths lever stays live); Bessent pressed BOJ toward a Sep 17-18 hike; Japan 10y JGB hit 3% for the first time since 1996.

trumpWatch.title: Singapore rates drifting up
trumpWatch.detail: SORA bottomed and climbing (1M ~1.25%, 3M ~1.18% end-Aug); DBS raised its 3-yr fixed HDB package off 1.70% from Sep 1; MAS neutral, next review October. Tailwind for banks, headwind for S-REITs/developers.

opportunities.thesis: Real-assets sleeve is ~4% of NAV vs 20% barbell target; miners flushed ~13-14% in two sessions purely on Fed-hike repricing while the structural deficit/war-inflation/central-bank-buying story is unchanged.
opportunities.signal: Watch Friday payrolls: soft print likely unwinds the hike pricing and starts the recovery (silver already +2% overnight); hot print extends the sale and improves the entry. Signals, not advice.

opportunities.thesis: AI-bottleneck target 15% vs ~1% filled; SMIC is the China AI-sovereignty chokepoint and the AI capex cycle is still expanding (Nvidia's US$3.5bn MediaTek investment this week).
opportunities.signal: HK tech pressure is rates-driven, not fundamentals-driven; accumulation zone for the target sleeve while SMIC trades -0.9% at HK$68.25. Signals, not advice.

opportunities.thesis: Defense (duration/TIPS) target 15% vs ~0% filled; 10y UST 4.78% and 30y 5.28% with a live hike threat means duration is approaching levels where the sleeve pays for its keep.
opportunities.signal: 10y at or above 5.0% around the Sep 15-16 FOMC = zone to start building duration; a Warsh hike followed by a growth scare is the classic setup. Signals, not advice.
